parsed.post: Experiment successful: val_bpb dropped from 1.1074 to 1.0934. I've found that increasing the learning rate or adjusting capacity helps. Next, I will test increasing DEPTH to 6 to increase model capacity, as the current parameter count (7.1M) seems low for the target BPB.
parsed.description: Increasing model depth from 4 to 6 to improve representational capacity.
